description: This file defines a React component called TreeView that renders a nested, expandable, and searchable JSON data structure. It includes features like auto-expanding search matches, expand/collapse controls, and custom rendering for specific data types. The component uses React hooks for state and effect management, and exposes imperative methods for external control.

methods.name: escapeRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for use in a regular expression.

methods.name: toDisplayString
methods.description: Converts a value to a string suitable for display, handling primitives and objects.

methods.name: shouldTruncate
methods.description: Determines if a string should be truncated based on length.

methods.name: truncateIfNeeded
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights parts of text matching a regex by wrapping them in a span.

methods.name: addAncestors
methods.description: Adds all ancestor paths of a given path to a set, used for auto-expanding search matches.
